verdict.rationale: Running a Linux environment inside another host OS is a fair question for an operating system. The only evidence is one community comment saying Windows 10 ships Ubuntu userland support (WSL), which points to a built-in Windows capability but says almost nothing about its depth. No first-party docs in the pack describe it. Missing for 10: first-party WSL documentation, evidence of a full Linux terminal and toolchain experience, hands-on corroboration of development workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a full Linux terminal environment inside another host OS for development and tooling
